Smooth driving saves battery. Bolts top you up, and braking at speed recovers charge.

How to play

▶Hold Gas to drive, let go to coast. Braking at speed recovers a little charge.
◀▶Steer, and slow down for bends or you'll slide.
⚡Bolts top up your battery. Coins buy upgrades in the garage.
?Mystery boxes give a magnet or a shield.
🛺Keep left: traffic comes at you, and slow carts share your lane.
★Press gas the moment "1" shows for a rocket start.
🔋2 laps = 100 km. The service stop gives +20%, but rivals keep racing.
⤴Hit the yellow ramps to jump and grab coins in the air. Smash cones and crates for coins. Watch out for cows!
⌨Keyboard: ↑ gas · ← → steer · ↓ brake · P pause · C service
